fork_fp16.label: ExLlamaV3 fp16 (the implementation used for the measurements)

hf_fp32resid.label: HF transformers bf16 + fp32 residual stream

notes: Text only. Measurement files and the pack were linked by name (the staged pack and the measured pack are the same artefact by construction, not by a hash recorded at measurement time).

protocol.excluding_worst_row: mean KL with the single worst row removed (mean_kl_excluding_worst_row, worst_row)
protocol.kl_ref_to_q: KL(reference || pack), nats per position; kl_q_to_ref is the opposite direction
protocol.numerics_floor_fork_bf16_vs_hf_bf16: KL(HF bf16 || ExLlamaV3 bf16): two bf16 implementations of the unquantised model
protocol.positions: every position of every row (tokens_per_row per row); statistics are over all positions
protocol.vs_fork_bf16: KL(reference || pack): reference = the bf16 checkpoint through the same ExLlamaV3 implementation (fp16 activations)
protocol.vs_hf_bf16: KL(reference || pack): reference = HF transformers bf16 forward of the same checkpoint, layer-streamed
